scripts.dev: bun run localstack && bun run cdklocal watch
scripts.localstack: LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /pawl/localstack/token --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text --profile jolo) docker compose -f ./node_modules/@pawl/cdk/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.cdklocal: LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /pawl/localstack/token --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text --profile jolo) AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 bunx cdklocal --app 'bun run local.dev.ts'
scripts.bootstrap:local: bun run localstack && bun run cdklocal bootstrap --all
scripts.deploy:local: bun run localstack && bun run bootstrap:local && bun run cdklocal deploy -- --all
scripts.remove:local: bun run localstack && bun run cdklocal destroy --all
